tests.name: Offline opening, resources and no external requests
Total tilt bound for normalized pointer grid
Pointer spotlight, real card corner tilt, and smooth reset
Shared pill retarget, different widths, and settled alignment
Tab keyboard semantics, focus and panels
Buttons, busy state and favorite toggle
Form validation, safe user text, selection and range
Native selection and synchronized switches
Dialog focus, Escape and return focus
Disclosure outside click and tooltip Escape
All four material presets and adjustable tokens
Controlled SVG refraction visibly changes edge pixels
Reduced-motion change disables tilt, refraction and springs
No-blur fallback keeps usable opaque surfaces
Idle animation loops stop
Mobile touch, panel overflow and navigation resizing
Forced colors preserves focus and selected state
Controller disposal removes pointer updates and RAF
No browser runtime errors
Final visual refinements: inward refraction and long-name mobile form

limitations: Only installed Microsoft Edge / Chromium tested; Safari and Firefox not tested.
SVG scene refraction is tested separately from arbitrary DOM backdrop refraction.
Visual review is not a full WCAG conformance audit.
